The plate is a square plate, roughly 24 cm across. The food on it is scrambled egg whites or a similar egg product, plus 2 slices of bacon.

The egg pile is about 8x8 cm and only a thin layer, so I estimate about 60 g. Egg whites run about 50 kcal per 100 g, which gives roughly 35 kcal for that pile. If it is whole egg, it would be closer to 90 kcal. The pieces look white and opaque, like egg-white patty chunks, so I'll estimate about 50 kcal.

The two bacon slices are probably cooked, at about 4 g each, which is 8 g and about 45 kcal in total.

That gives roughly 68 g and 95 kcal. I'll round this up slightly to allow for any oil.
